title: Vero: Can AI Agents Build Formally Verified Software Repositories?

change.en: Moves the verified code generation test from single functions to whole repositories. The agent writes the implementation and proves every specification, and one missing proof means the repository isn't solved.
change.zh: 把验证代码生成的考题从单个函数扩大到整个仓库：agent 要自己写实现，再证明它满足全部规约，少一条都不算解出。
